'''Rodian wine''' was a [[Wine/Legends|wine]] from [[Rodia/Legends|Rodia]]. [[Rodian/Legends|Rodian]] merchant [[Teeloo]] considered it to be the best stuff in [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], and had some Rodian wine in his cargo when he went to the [[Cularin system/Legends|Cularin system]].
